data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket storing model artifacts used by the model server and updated by ML engineers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_stores.notes: The source says artifact integrity is not verified and that the bucket is trusted.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features used by the model server.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Redis feature store on the same network. ... The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing requests and responses for debugging.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts that sometimes carry whatever calling-team users typed.
